description.value: Dickens Liquor Shoppe is a full-service private liquor retailer on Sidney's main commercial street, Beacon Avenue, operating as a local institution since 1988. It stocks wine, spirits, and beer with regular sale pricing and a members loyalty program offering points and discounts. A delivery service is available, and the store is within easy walking distance of Sidney's waterfront cycling routes.
